text:
Ava (CS): quick heads-up — we're piloting a 45-min "micro-sprint" for the new Subscriber cohort next Tue/Wed. need 2 hosts + 1 guest trainer; prefer EMEA-friendly windows.
Miguel: I can host but only mornings CET.
Priya: afternoons CET work for me; happy to be backup host.
Ava (CS): thinking of these candidate slots:
```
Tue 09:00-09:45 CET (EMEA primary)
Tue 16:00-16:45 CET (EMEA late / US overlap)
Wed 08:30-09:15 CET (short follow-up)
```
Sam: Tue 16:00 OK for me (US EST overlap). I can demo the rollout checklist.
Ava (CS): perfect. who can guest-train on "Quantized batching best practices"? want a 15m demo + Q&A.
Miguel: I can do the demo, will prep a 10-slide deck. :thumbsup: 
Priya: if Miguel covers the demo, I can run the hands-on lab (15m) — will bring a tiny prompt set and a sandbox link.
Ava (CS): volunteers: Miguel (demo), Priya (lab), Sam (checklist). still need one host to own invites + recording ops.
OnboardBot: Reminder: add calendar_event with attendee list and recording enabled. Use template: onboard/sprint-microsession.
Ava (CS): @Sam can you create the calendar event and attach the invite template, prework link, and a 1-question feedback form?
Sam: will do. drafting invite now — slot Tue 16:00 CET (converts to Tue 10:00 EDT). I'll include timezone note + brief agenda.
Ava (CS): rough agenda: 5m intro, 15m quant batching demo, 15m hands-on lab, 10m checklist + wrap/Q&A.
Priya: added a short prework doc to Drive + a 1-question feedback Google Form; put links in the invite.
Miguel: attaching slides + a tiny runbook; flag me if infra blocks appear.
Ava (CS): please react with :white_check_mark: once invites are sent. I'll collect post-session feedback and flag any renewal-risk signals.
Sam: invites sent. :white_check_mark:
Miguel: :white_check_mark:
Priya: :white_check_mark:
Ava (CS): thanks — I'll tag CS leads after the session to triage any attendee responses that say "needs follow-up."
Ava (CS) (post-note): if conflicts pop up, I can swap Tue 16:00 <-> Tue 09:00 — shout here if we need to flip.
